title: MayersScott/rkn-block-checker
claim: MayersScott/rkn-block-checker — Diagnose RKN/TSPU internet blocks layer by layer (DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP)
why_good: Diagnoses RKN/TSPU internet blocks by analyzing failures at DNS, TCP, TLS, and HTTP layers. Outputs a clear verdict for each site, with confidence levels calibrated by signal strength.
value: Network administrators and censorship circumvention developers use it to diagnose interference and optimize mitigation strategies.
risk: Could struggle against Roskomnadzor's evolving censorship techniques or face redundancy if ISPs adopt more opaque blocking methods.
does: Diagnoses RKN/TSPU internet blocks by analyzing failures at DNS, TCP, TLS, and HTTP layers. Outputs a clear verdict for each site, with confidence levels calibrated by signal strength.
edge: Unique ability to classify block types (e.g., DNS poisoning, TLS DPI) with high confidence using multi-layer probing.
why_use: Unlike generic 'site unreachable' messages, it identifies the exact censorship mechanism, enabling users to choose the right circumvention tools or report precise issues.
hook: Pinpoint RKN censorship layer-by-layer with 21 control sites and 15 restricted targets.

zh.hook: 逐层定位RKN审查，覆盖21个控制站点和15个受限目标。
zh.does: 通过分析DNS、TCP、TLS和HTTP层的故障，诊断RKN/TSPU互联网封锁。为每个站点输出清晰的判决，并根据信号强度校准信心等级。
zh.edge: 通过多层探测，高置信度分类封锁类型（如DNS污染、TLS DPI）的独特能力。
zh.why_use: 与普通的“网站无法访问”消息不同，它能识别具体的审查机制，使用户能够选择合适的规避工具或报告精确的问题。
zh.value: 网络管理员和审查规避开发者使用它诊断干扰并优化缓解策略。
zh.risk: 可能难以应对Roskomnadzor不断发展的审查技术，或在ISP采用更不透明的封锁方法时面临功能冗余的风险。
zh.why_good: 通过分析DNS、TCP、TLS和HTTP层的故障，诊断RKN/TSPU互联网封锁。为每个站点输出清晰的判决，并根据信号强度校准信心等级。
zh.claim: MayersScott/rkn-block-checker — 逐层诊断 RKN/TSPU 网络封锁（DNS、TCP、TLS、HTTP）
